statement: Executed under issue #9 (Recovery from Issue #8 hard-lock failure). Authorized: GATE_TRANSITION G7 only. NOT authorized: RAW_READ_DOWNLOAD, G8. No new raw-read download is performed; only the already-present local PRJNA678459 FASTQ files are used. If exact frozen membership is missing or incomplete, stop BLOCKED.

This gate does not recompute or change: G4 QC rules (metadata/g4/g4_qc_rules.tsv, sha256 unchanged), G5 caller rules (metadata/g5/g5_caller_rules.tsv, sha256 unchanged), G5 repeat catalogue (metadata/g5/g5_repeat_catalogue.tsv, unchanged), G6/G7 locus eligibility classes (metadata/g7/g7_locus_analysis_universe.tsv: 261 PRIMARY_TECHNICAL, 39 PROVISIONAL_TECHNICAL, 1105 PRIMARY_INELIGIBLE, unchanged).

Expected PRJNA678459 run/biosample membership is taken only from the already-harmonized metadata/harmonized/run_linkage.tsv and metadata/g7/g7_targeted_raw_read_download_proposal.tsv (both written in prior committed/reviewed gates). Verification compares local data/raw/g7_followup/PRJNA678459/* files against this expectation by run accession, mate count, byte size (est_bytes column) and gzip integrity. No network call is made; ENA md5 is not available offline in this run, so Q01 (G4 rule) is evaluated as byte-size + gzip-integrity match only, and reported as PASS_SIZE_ONLY, not a full md5 PASS. This limitation is disclosed, not hidden.

QC is run with the unmodified frozen G4 rule thresholds (Q02-Q17; no threshold changed) except Q01 (F03) and Q06 (ena_read_count not available offline; reported NA, not fabricated). REVISED TWICE (disclosed, before any final QC result was produced): (1) a full-file pure-Python parse timed out under this gate's no-background-job constraint, so Q02 (malformed-record check), Q05 (mate-name consistency) and Q10 (N-content) are computed from a bounded prefix of the first 200000 read pairs per run (PARTIAL_PREFIX_CHECK, disclosed, not exhaustive); (2) full-file fastp also timed out (over 100 s and still running on one sample at ~500x+ raw depth), so Q07-Q09/Q11-Q13 (depth, length, quality, GC, adapter, duplication) instead use fastp's own --reads_to_process 500000 bound (measured 18 s for 1000000 pairs on one sample; 500000 pairs used here), reported as a BOUNDED_SUBSAMPLE depth estimate, not the true full-file depth. Q14 identity k-mer screen unchanged (already a 20000-read sample per the frozen rule). All caps are the same order as the caller cap in F05 for consistency.

The frozen G5 spanning-read caller (scripts/g5/g5caller, rules unchanged) is applied to all 10 PRJNA678459 samples. For runtime boundedness under the synchronous, non-backgrounded execution constraint of this gate, extraction is capped at 500000 read fragments (pairs) per sample (BOUNDED_SUBSAMPLE_FOR_RUNTIME, same order as the QC cap in F04; disclosed per sample with achieved bases/depth; caller thresholds themselves are unchanged). Reporting is restricted to the 261 PRIMARY_TECHNICAL and 39 PROVISIONAL_TECHNICAL loci, kept in separate tables/columns; PRIMARY_INELIGIBLE loci are not analyzed.

No disease label, stage, or country field is used as a filter, grouping variable, or comparison axis anywhere in QC, identity, caller, or structure outputs. AG and GC labels exist in upstream metadata for these 10 BioSamples (metadata/harmonized/run_linkage.tsv) but are not read by any script in scripts/g7_followup, and are not tabulated against callability or PV state. No AG-vs-GC comparison, ranking, p-value, or effect size is computed.

Population-structure update reuses the G7 SCREENING_STRUCTURE_ONLY own-implementation k-mer/MinHash method (k=21, bottom-1000 sketch, zlib.crc32) unchanged, extended with read-based sketches built from a bounded read sample of the first 30000 read pairs (about 9 Mb of sequence, roughly 5x nominal H. pylori genome coverage in unique-k-mer terms, sufficient for a bottom-1000 sketch to converge; disclosed as BOUNDED_SUBSAMPLE, timed against the existing per-genome sketch throughput of about 370 kb/s before choosing this cap) of the 10 PRJNA678459 samples, added as new points relative to the existing 32-genome G7 distance matrix. This is a technical/structure comparison only; it does not use or report disease labels.

G8 readiness classifications are descriptive/technical only (data availability, patient independence tier, confounding structure, callability), not a disease-effect estimate. No G8 work is started; G8 remains NOT_STARTED/UNAUTHORIZED regardless of classification outcome.

On completion, current_gate=G7 and last_completed_gate=G7 are recorded per the issue's GATE_TRANSITION G7 authorization, together with the supervisor's G7 closure decision (PASS_WITH_WARNINGS) as communicated in issue #9. This gate (g7_followup) is recorded as a bounded technical follow-up executed under that same closure; it does not reopen or re-litigate the G7 substantive findings already committed.
